hooks.command: CMD=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('tool_input',d).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *)   [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] &&   echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: knowledge graph at graphify-out/. For focused questions, run `graphify query \"<question>\"` (scoped subgraph, usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md) instead of grepping raw files. Read GRAPH_REPORT.md only for broad architecture context."}}'   || true ;; esac

python3 -c "import json,sys,re,subprocess as sp; d=json.load(sys.stdin); cmd=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''); m1=re.search(r'git\s+push\s+(\S+\s+)?(main\b|v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\b)', cmd); m2=re.match(r'^\s*git\s+push\s*(origin)?\s*$', cmd); branch=(sp.run(['git','branch','--show-current'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3).stdout.strip() if (m2 and not m1) else ''); risky = bool(m1) or (bool(m2) and branch=='main'); print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','permissionDecision':'ask','permissionDecisionReason':'Standing rule: confirm before pushing main or a release tag, even after verification or a prior approval this session.'}})) if risky else None" 2>/dev/null || true

python3 -c "import json,sys,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ti=d.get('tool_input',{}); path=ti.get('file_path') or ti.get('path') or ''; base=path.rsplit('/',1)[-1]; ok = re.match(r'^\.env(\..+)?$', base) and 'example' not in base.lower(); print(json.dumps({'decision':'block','reason':'Blocked: editing '+base+' — this project shares one production Firebase/Firestore project with no dev or staging environment, and this file holds live secrets. Edit it manually outside Claude Code if this is intentional.'})) if ok else None" 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */graphify-out/*|graphify-out/*|"") exit 0;; esac; [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && graphify update .; } >/tmp/claude-graphify-posttooluse.log 2>&1 || true
